 Livestream: Detroit City Clerk to go over election preparedness ahead of Election Day
 Press conference to begin at 11 a.m. on Oct. 29
 Samantha Sayles , Senior Digital Producer
 Published:  October 29, 2026 at 10:56 AM Tags:  Decision 2026 , Detroit , Wayne County DETROIT – The Detroit City Clerk is expected to hold a press conference on Thursday to talk about election preparedness as Election Day approaches.
 Detroit City Clerk Janice Winfrey and other department officials are expected to give an overview of election preparations. The overview will also cover security measures and polling-place readiness.
 Election officials will also attend the press conference to answer media questions.
 You can watch the event live when it begins at the top of this article.
